name: Imechen! My Sister~!
source:
Your adorable little sister Momoka just made a pubescent confession!

She positively begged you. Just once, just this one mistake is okay.

...you promised yourself, but after tasting sweet Momoka there's no going back.

Your fantasy thoughts can't be repressed!

How far will this forbidden love go...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ112701.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
可爱的妹妹桃香正值青春期，向你告白了！

她苦苦央求你。就一次，只犯这一次错也没关系。

…你原本是这样答应自己的。可一旦尝过了与桃香相恋的甜蜜，就再也回不了头。你也再按捺不住心中的幻想！

这段禁忌之恋，究竟会走到哪里…？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ112701.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
